title: PlayCoder: Making LLM-Generated GUI Code Playable
summary: A multi-agent framework by Tencent designed to fix behavioral and logic errors in LLM-generated GUI code. It employs automated interaction testing and visual feedback to ensure generated applications are functional beyond mere compilation.
research_notes: Includes PlayTester, which uses vision-language models to verify GUI state via screenshots and simulated user interactions.

evolution.summary: Transitioned from an early research prototype to a comprehensive multi-agent system including PlayDeveloper, PlayRefiner, and PlayTester components. It was featured at FSE 2026 as a major advancement in automated program repair for GUIs.
